source.title: The Mad King
source.description: You find a dirty, tattered notebook full of scribbled schematics and notes. It's quite clear even after just a cursory glance that any of these creations could be used to wreak terrible havoc should anyone ever be foolish enough to build them.
source.objective: Bring Thermaplugg's Engineering Notes to High Tinker Mekkatorque at Tinker Town in Ironforge.
source.progress: <name>, what is it you have there?
source.completion:
I can't thank you enough for recovering these schematics. I shudder to think what would have become of Ironforge  had Thermaplugg been able to bring these creations to bear against us.

This calls for a celebration!
